newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says truck deliveries fell in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says truck deliveries fell in Jan-May.

text.p: Volvo Trucks said on Friday its worldwide truck sales fell six percent to 26,017 in the first five months of 1997 compared with 27,577 in the same 1996 period.
Volvo said European deliveries fell 14 percent to 13,431 in the first five months of this year, but deliveries in all other sectors rose.

North American deliveries rose three percent to 7,894, South American deliveries rose 13 percent to 2,330 and deliveries to other markets rose four percent to 2,362 for the five month period -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004.
